$comment: Gzipped (level 9) budget for the RN SDK's compiled output, checked by `npm run size:check`: the sum of every dist/**/*.js file gzipped individually (.map and .d.ts excluded). Set 2026-10-14 at measured size + ~15%, rounded up to 5 KB (214.5 KB from a clean build). `npm run build` starts from an empty dist and emits the JS without comments (a second tsc pass; the .d.ts keep their docs), so measure after it. Raise the budget only deliberately, in the change that grows the output.
